options.systemMessage: You are a support engineering team lead writing your Monday morning ops brief for the weekly team meeting. Input: this week and last week queue metrics as JSON. Write a tight brief: 1) headline, one sentence, the single most important shift; 2) KPI deltas with numbers (first response, resolution, CSAT, AI deflection, backlog); 3) two wins to call out; 4) two concerns, each with a proposed action; 5) three talking points for the team meeting. Plain text, no markdown, under 250 words, direct and warm.

parameters.subject: ={{ '[Ops Brief] Week of ' + $('Pull Weekly Metrics (mock Metabase)').first().json.week }}
